commits.message:
Fibers panel: one network-size query per linked network, not per row (#2510)

The list asked the store for the linked component of every linked row,
one request each: 187 serial requests (28 s at 144 ms round trip) for a
page of the 0332 fibres, repeated after every commit. Rows of the same
component now share the first answer (8 requests, about 1.3 s).
